mapper.insert: INSERT INTO candidate_learning_session(task_idtraining_id,candidate_name,phone,token) VALUES(#{taskId},#{candidateName},#{phone},#{token}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.update: UPDATE candidate_learning_session s LEFT JOIN training t ON t.id=s.training_id LEFT JOIN assessment_task a ON a.id=s.task_id JOIN organization_employee e ON e.created_by=COALESCE(t.created_by,a.created_by) AND e.name=s.candidate_name AND e.phone=s.phone AND e.status='ACTIVE' SET s.employee_id=e.id WHERE s.employee_id IS NULL AND s.task_idtraining_id=#{taskId} AND s.candidate_name=#{candidateName} AND s.phone=#{phone}
mapper.select: SELECT id,token FROM candidate_learning_session WHERE task_idtraining_id=#{taskId} AND candidate_name=#{candidateName} AND phone=#{phone}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO candidate_video_progress(session_id,video_id) SELECT #{sessionId},v.id FROM training_video v JOIN training t ON t.id=v.training_id WHERE t.assessment_id=#{taskId}t.id=#{taskId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidate_learning_session learner JOIN training_audience r ON r.candidate_name=learner.candidate_name AND r.phone=learner.phone WHERE learner.id=#{sessionId} AND r.training_id=t.id)
mapper.select: SELECT v.id,v.training_id trainingId,v.title,p.position_seconds positionSeconds,p.completed FROM training_video v JOIN training t ON t.id=v.training_id JOIN candidate_video_progress p ON p.video_id=v.id AND p.session_id=#{sessionId} WHERE t.assessment_id=#{taskId}t.id=#{taskId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidate_learning_session learner JOIN training_audience r ON r.candidate_name=learner.candidate_name AND r.phone=learner.phone WHERE learner.id=#{sessionId} AND r.training_id=t.id) ORDER BY t.id,v.sort_order,v.id

SELECT v.*,p.session_id FROM training_video v JOIN training t ON t.id=v.training_id JOIN candidate_video_progress p ON p.video_id=v.id JOIN candidate_learning_session s ON s.id=p.session_id WHERE t.assessment_id=#{taskId}t.id=#{taskId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM training_audience r WHERE r.training_id=t.id AND r.candidate_name=s.candidate_name AND r.phone=s.phone) AND s.task_idtraining_id=#{sessionTaskId} AND s.token=#{token} AND v.id=#{videoId}
SELECT candidate_name,phone FROM candidate_learning_session WHERE token=#{token} AND task_idtraining_id=#{taskId}

SELECT studied_seconds,last_play_position,GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,updated_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))/1000000.0) recent_elapsed,position_seconds,baseline_position,completed,GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,baseline_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))/1000000.0) elapsed FROM candidate_video_progress WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND video_id=#{videoId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE candidate_video_progress SET position_seconds=#{positionSeconds},completed=#{completed},studied_seconds=#{studiedSeconds},last_play_position=#{playPosition},first_studied_at=COALESCE(first_studied_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)),completed_at=IF(#{markCompleted} AND completed_at IS NULL,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),completed_at),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND video_id=#{videoId}
